name: Kochariya-East Danuwar

earlier_scan.note: Glottolog meds are wordlists only (Shackelford et al. 2018; van Driem 2001 survey pages); no grammar/phonology of Kochariya-East Danuwar found.

sources.note: Nothing. Survey points include Bhaluwahi (Hatpate-6, Sindhuli) and Kachhadiya Tole (Nijgadh-4, Bara) = koch1253 area. sources.citation: Sapkota, Madhusudan. 2014. sources.note: Nothing. Danuwari speakers of Nipane, Hatpate and Sirthauli VDCs, eastern Sindhuli (= koch1253). Segment/word-level error analysis only (a/aa, retroflex/dental, j/jh, y/e, v/b, h-loss, prothetic i-); the word balaghat 'stress' never occurs.

sources.note: A Nepali-medium 'vyakaranatmak svarup' (grammatical structure) monograph normally opens with a varna/dhvani (sound system) chapter listing vowels and consonants; whether it says anything about pitch/tone (sur, tan) or stress (balaghat) is unknown -- likely silent or a one-line remark. Would be the only published grammar-type description centred on the koch1253 variety.
